28.name: Episode 1
28.overview: A time-warping new season of Big Brother begins as 14 new houseguests turn back time and collide with the past's greatest reality legends in three era-spanning competitions. Then, tragedy strikes in the Jurassic Period and a houseguest meets their untimely demise.

28.name: Big Brother Unlocked 7/10/26
28.overview: A new season of Big Brother: Unlocked kicks off with hosts Taylor Hale and Derrick Levasseur dishing all the never-before seen drama from the Big Brother 28 house, joined by new co-host Jerry O'Connell! Then, BB legend Rachel Reilly tells-all about her experience meeting the new houseguests and everyone makes their predictions for the upcoming season.

28.name: Episode 3
28.overview: The first Head of Household of BB28 will be crowned! And the first three nominees of the summer will hit the block. Plus, is it showmance o'clock already?

28.name: Episode 4
28.overview: It's the inaugural Veto competition of the season, with a couple of BB legends joining the fun. Who will win the Golden Power of Veto? Will it be used to save one of the nominees?

28.name: Episode 5
28.overview: Ashley, Taylor, and Yash compete in the BB Block Buster! Who will win safety, and who will be the first evicted?

28.name: Episode 6
28.overview: America, find out who you sent into the BB Time Capsule. What power or punishment will be unleashed? Plus, who will become the new Head of Household? And which three Houseguests will hit the block? Then, it is the craziest Nomination Ceremony in BB history!

28.name: Episode 7
28.overview: Tears, fights, and an egg ready to crack. Then, the Power of Veto is on the line! Will it save one of the nominees from doom?

28.name: Episode 8
28.overview: Tonight Rome, Melody, and Jason go to battle at The BB Blockbuster. Who will escape the chopping block, and which of them will be the next sent packing?

28.name: Big Brother: Unlocked 7/24/26
28.overview: Jerry, Taylor, and Derrick break down the crazy week that was! Watch the fallout from the emotional eviction. The powers and punishments within the BB Time Capsule are revealed! A body-slamming Head of Household competition kicks off, and Celebrity Big Brother alumnus Ross Mathews gives his unique insight into the game.

28.name: Episode 10
28.overview: Tonight who will piledrive into power, and which three houseguests will be nominated next?

28.name: Episode 11
28.overview: Will Kamu's plan come to fruition? It all comes down to a pickle of a Veto Competition... and tea will be spilled.

28.name: Episode 12
28.overview: Mallory, LaTrice, and Jason go to battle in the BB Blockbuster - who will save their game, and who will be the next Houseguest sent packing?

28.name: Episode 13
28.overview: The Head of Household is back up for grabs! Who will slay their way to power?

28.name: Episode 14
28.overview: With Drew in danger, will the Toolshed have his back or stab him in it? Then, the Power of Veto is on the line. Can a nominee win their safety? Plus, BB 27’s Morgan is back!

28.name: Episode 15
28.overview: Will the BB Blockbuster be Drew, Lyric or Melody's salvation? Which one of them will be the next sent home?

28.name: Big Brother: Unlocked 8/07/26
28.overview: Jerry, Taylor, and Derrick welcome BB19 winner Josh Martinez!

28.name: Episode 17
28.overview: Learn how the shocker of the season took shape. Then, the House goes to war on the Wall! Who will become the new HOH and who will they nominate for eviction?

28.name: Episode 18
28.overview: The Power of Veto is up for grabs. Whose game will be staying alive? Plus, run for cover! Mount St. Angela is about to erupt!

28.name: Episode 19
28.overview: Barrett, Chuk, and Haley will clash at The BB Block Buster! One of them will win safety, and one will be the next Houseguest sent packing!

28.name: Episode 20
28.overview: The Head of Household is back up for grabs! Who will ascend into power? Plus, in the BB Time Capsule, Devens won the Diamond Power of Veto and Dee earned the BB Bribe. Will the houseguest you choose win a power inside the Time Capsule tonight, or will a punishment be unleashed?

28.name: Episode 21
28.overview: The Power of Veto is up for grabs at the iconic OTEV competition. Who will win the Golden Power? Plus, with his top ally in jeopardy, will Devens unleash his Diamond Power?

28.name: Episode 22
28.overview: It's the fallout from the shocker of the season; then Angela, Haley, and Kamu clash at The BB Block Buster. One will win safety, and one will be the next evicted.

28.name: Episode 23
28.overview: After a week of crazy gameplay, the Head of Household is back up for grabs! Who will win and who will they nominate for eviction? Then, who did you choose to be the final Houseguest to enter the BB Time Capsule, and what power or punishment will they earn? Plus, BB legend Paul surprises the Houseguests! And speaking of legends, the BB Unlocked crew welcome Danielle Reyes to help kick off this supersized episode.

28.name: Episode 24
28.overview: The fireworks continue! Then, the Power of Veto is on the line. Will one of the nominees win safety?

28.name: Episode 25
28.overview: The historic night will feature surprise appearances from former Houseguests determined by interactive fan votes and kick off the biggest twist of the summer. The episode will look back at some of the most memorable moments from the show's historic 26-year run and shift into overdrive with the BB Blockbuster and a live eviction.

28.name: Episode 26
28.overview: An all-new never before seen twist is unleashed! And it will have dire consequences for one of the Houseguests.

28.name: Episode 27
28.overview: Who will Barrett choose and which Houseguest will have their Big Brother game ended? Then, Zingbot arrives to roast the final nine! Plus, a new Head of Household will be crowned, three new nominees hit the block, and a veto will be won.

28.name: Episode 28
28.overview: Devins, Lala, and Taylor go to battle! Will the Survivor survive The BB Blockbuster, or will an Icon be the first member of the BB jury?

28.name: Big Brother: Unlocked 9/4/2026
28.overview: It's the fallout from the Eviction. Jerry, Taylor, and Derrick welcome Jay Mohr to break down the crazy week in BB. Zingbot has an encore performance, and no one is safe! The next Head of Household Competition kicks off!

28.name: Episode 30
28.overview: With only eight remaining and the house split in two, it’s a must-win Head of Household competition! Who will ascend into power? Plus, Dee and Devens have been ride-or-die since Day 1, but are the Survivor Icons ready to turn on each other?

28.name: Episode 31
28.overview: The Nom Ceremony conflict continues! Then, the Veto is on the line in the legendary BB Comics Competition! Will one of the Icons save their game?

28.name: Episode 32
28.overview: Angela, Devens, and Dee go to battle in the BB Blockbuster! Who will survive, and which icon will be sent to the jury?

28.name: Episode 33
28.overview: With only seven remaining, a crucial Head of Household is up for grabs! Who will earn power? And which three Houseguests will hit the block?!

28.name: Episode 34
28.overview: The Power of Veto is on the line in the Pressure Cooker competition! Will Drew, Barrett, or Melody endure and earn their safety?

28.name: Episode 35
28.overview: Barrett, Melody, and Taylor battle in the final Block Buster of the summer! Who will win, and who will be sent to jury? Then another houseguest will be sent packing because its a doub eviction baby!! A full week of gameplay in one nonstop night! Will one of the Survivors go, or is another newbie next? When the dust settles who will make the final five?

28.name: Big Brother: Unlocked 9/18/2026
28.overview: The fallout from the shocking Double Eviction!  Jerry and Derrick welcome BB 26 winner Chelsie.  Along with special guest James Gunn.  Plus, the BB Awards, chosen by you, America!  We launch the vote for America's Favorite Houseguest.

28.name: Episode 37
28.overview: See everything you missed during the jaw-dropping double! Then, season 27 runner-up Vince returns to kick off a crazy new twist! Plus, they survived the Pressure Cooker, but can they survive one of the most excruciating HOH comps ever?! Who will stack up power, and which two Houseguests will be nominated?

28.name: Episode 38
28.overview: Find out who Devens nominates! Then, the Houseguests return to Egypt to try and secure the Veto. Plus, someone’s game will come to an end in the dreaded Egyptian Eviction! And when the dust settles, the final four will be set.

28.name: Episode 39
28.overview: Three Crossovers are left, two Icons have survived, and one Taylor remains. Which one will win the Head of Household? Who will secure the final and most important Veto of the season? And ultimately, which one will be sent to jury next? We are one week away from crowning a winner, and tonight we get down to the final three.

28.name: Episode 40
28.overview: It’s the fallout from Dee’s eviction. Then, hilarious moments from the summer you haven’t seen! And Melody’s Jury House arrival erupts into fireworks! Plus, Part 1 of the three-part, final Head of Household Competition kicks off!

28.name: Episode 41
28.overview: Devens, Drew, and Taylor embark on the endgame. Who will win the three part Head of Household competition and earn the power to cast the last eviction vote of the season. The jury also returns to pick the winner of the three quarters of a million dollars grand prize!

overview: American version of the reality game show which follows a group of HouseGuests living together 24 hours a day in the "Big Brother" house, isolated from the outside world but under constant surveillance with no privacy for three months.

seasons.name: Specials
seasons.overview: Various specials shown before a season of Big Brother starts.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Big Brother 2000 was a near-exact port of the hit Netherlands (Holland) series of the same name. Every week, Housemates would nominate two fellow housemates and the two or more housemates with the most nominations were eligible for banishment. American viewers could then call a 1-900 number and cast a vote to banish a HouseGuest.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: This season brings a complete reformatting of Big Brother 1. The introduction of the Head of Household (HOH). The HOH nominates two houseguests for eviction. The fellow contestants vote, and the player with the most votes is evicted. On finale night, all former houseguests returned to vote for who they think should win the grand prize.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: This season brings about more changes to the Big Brother format - the introduction of the Silver and Golden Power of Vetos.

seasons.name: The X-Factor
seasons.overview: In this season's twist, ten of the thirteen houseguests are shocked to learn that they will compete alongside their exes. In addition, introduction of the Diamond Power of Veto and the sequestered Jury.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In this season's twists, there are two sets of pre-existing relationships in the house - secret twins and long lost siblings.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: In this season's twist, every houseguest enters the house with a secret partner - believing they were the only pair.  If both can reach the end, the winner would receive a grand prize of $1,000,000 and the runner-up, $250,000.

seasons.name: All Stars
seasons.overview: Fourteen of the best and most iconic Big Brother Houseguests make their return to compete for the $500,000 grand prize.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: In the season's twists, 3 houseguests are shocked to learn their "enemy" will be entering the game - ex best friends, ex-boyfriends, and an estranged father and daughter.

seasons.name: 'Til Death Do You Part
seasons.overview: In the season's twist, every houseguest would compete, be nominated, and be evicted as couples.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: In the twist of the summer, three Dynamic Duos of iconic previous houseguests make their return for another chance to win - Dick and Daniele, Jordan and Jeff, Rachel and Brendon.

seasons.name: Season 14
seasons.overview: In the season's twist, four previous houseguests return as Coaches to build a Big Brother dream team - a $100,000 prize awaits the coach who picks the Big Brother winner.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview:
This season's twist brings about the Battle of Block - two HOHs, 4 nominations, and the chance of an HOH being evicted.

Big Brother 16 brings about the beginning of the HD era with brand new cameras and more mics than ever.

seasons.name: Season 17
seasons.overview: This season brings back the iconic Twin Twist with two sisters swapping out every few days, unbeknownist to the other houseguests. The Battle of the Block makes it return.

seasons.name: Season 19
seasons.overview: Season 19's new twist is called “Summer of Temptation,” where the Houseguests will be challenged like never before as they embark on a season of tempting offers that could give them money, power and safety in the game. But, they will need to be careful, because for every temptation taken, there will be a consequence to face. This season's house reflects the temptation twist with words like Money and Revenge hanging on the wall, constantly reminding the Houseguests that the game never stops.

seasons.name: Season 20
seasons.overview: It's the Summer of Technology with the house decked out in high-tech. The BB App Store gets it start, as Houseguests purchase upgrades to improve their game. Plus, the H@cker enters the game to shake things up.

seasons.name: Season 21
seasons.overview: This season Houseguests get a special entry into Camp Big Brother, a rustic summer camp with secrets. A summer filled with Camp Directors, Comebacks, Field Trips, and Pranks.

seasons.name: All Stars 2
seasons.overview: Sixteen former Houseguests return to the game for a second chance at the grand prize of $500,000.

seasons.name: Season 25
seasons.overview: It is the Summer of the BB Multiverse. Three former Houseguests enter the house and unleash four universes onto the house. The Comic, Humili, Scary, and Scramble-verses unlock new twists and themed competition.

seasons.name: Season 26
seasons.overview: This season is the Summer of Artificial Intelligence. A.I. bots  Ainsley and Jankie take over and introduce a brand new competion that changes the game - the A.I. Arena.

seasons.name: Season 27
seasons.overview:
This season is the Summer of Mystery as the Houseguests enter the Hotel Mystère, a place where secrets lurk behind every door and nothing is as it seems.

This season celebrates the 25-year anniversary of the series as a whole.

seasons.name: Season 28
seasons.overview: The theme of the summer is the BB Time Trip, sending Houseguests on a journey unlike anything ever seen before–from prehistoric times to iconic decades and unforgettable moments from Big Brother history.

title: Big Brother
